name: dsh-dialog-fence
description: 对话围栏：一套对所有对话生效的通用规则 + 可选的按对话追加的专属规则，全部存在一个位置可自定义的 JSON 文件里，以固定顺序注入运行时上下文快照（不破坏前缀缓存、纯追加、压缩后仍存活）。每条规则右侧有独立开关可随时单独停用；还可以勾选「不使用围栏的对话」让若干对话整体跳过围栏（规则保留，取消勾选即恢复）。按标准 DSH bundle 安装，出现在「插件 → 已安装」，可用官方安装器装卸；规则可在设置页、包详情页与会话浮层里编辑。 / A dialogue fence: a shared rule list that applies to every conversation plus an optional per-session list, stored in one JSON file whose location is customizable, injected into the runtime-context snapshot at a fixed order (cache-safe, append-only, compression-durable). Every rule carries its own on/off switch, and a per-session exclusion list lets chosen conversations skip the fence entirely (their rules stay intact and come back when unchecked). Installs as a normal DSH bundle, so it shows up under Plugins -> Installed and can be installed/removed with the official installer; rules are edited on the Settings page, in its own bundle page, and in the conversation panel.
